Title: Register valid user
Steps: 1. Send valid registration payload. 2. Observe response. 3. Query users table.
Expected Result: HTTP 200; user created; DB row exists for email.

Title: Register invalid email
Steps: 1. Send malformed email. 2. Observe status code.

Title: Login valid credentials
Steps: 1. Send valid email/password. 2. Verify token returned.

Title: Get products list
Steps: 1. Request product collection. 2. Inspect JSON response.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 and array of product objects.

Title: Create valid order
Preconditions: Logged-in user and product stock available
Steps: 1. Create order payload. 2. Submit request. 3. Check response. 4. Inspect orders/order_items.
Expected Result: HTTP 200; order and items persisted; stock updated.

Title: Create order with insufficient stock
Steps: 1. Submit quantity above stock. 2. Review response.

Title: Verify user row after registration
Steps: 1. Query users table. 2. Match email and created record.

Title: Verify order and item persistence
Steps: 1. Query latest order. 2. Join order_items. 3. Inspect totals and quantities.
Expected Result: Order data and line items match payload.

Title: Verify stock decrement
Expected Result: Stock value decreases by placed quantity.

Title: Verify audit log entry
Steps: 1. Query recent audit_logs. 2. Match event message.
Expected Result: Entry exists with timestamp and level.
